result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers name the four problem behaviors and propose better defaults with copy-from-hive. B is stronger on the save model: changes apply immediately with Undo toasts, sync status shows inline, and the reset is split by scope with an Undo snapshot where possible. A says reordering is 'almost certainly the main cause' of the reviews, which overclaims, while B keeps its claims hedged and lists specific signals to watch after release. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers name all four problem behaviors and propose good defaults, a better save model, and grouping that keeps every option. A handles recoverability a little better, with Undo toasts, a scoped reset and snapshots. B wins on the shipping question: it suggests tallying the existing reviews and support tickets, adding specific instrumentation and running a quick internal task check. B does overclaim by calling the engineering-order layout 'almost certainly the main cause'.
